title: Add RecipeImageLoader async helper
description: Create RecipeImageLoader.swift with an async function (or actor) that accepts a recipe source-file URL obtained from the security-scoped bookmark established in 0003. It searches for a sibling file sharing the same base name with extensions .jpg, .jpeg, .png, .heic (in that order), calls startAccessingSecurityScopedResource() before reading, and stopAccessingSecurityScopedResource() in all exit paths (success and failure). Returns a SwiftUI Image on success or nil when no sibling exists.
acceptance_criteria: startAccessingSecurityScopedResource() is called before any file-system access.
stopAccessingSecurityScopedResource() is called in all exit paths.
Extensions are tried in order: jpg, jpeg, png, heic.
Returns nil without throwing when no sibling image exists.
Returns a non-nil Image when a valid sibling is found.
